Using this website

This version of the website has no enquiry form, account system, advertising scripts or site analytics. It does not set application cookies or store visitor information in your browser.

Hosting

The hosting provider may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver and protect the website. Hosting access controls may apply their own cookies.

Contacting us

Our contact links take you to LinkedIn. If you follow those links or send a message there, LinkedIn’s privacy policy and terms apply. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information in an initial enquiry.
